title: Limiting Liability: Penalty, Exemption, Force Majeure
grammar: Liability clauses and what the law does not allow
goal: I can name the clauses that limit or exclude liability (*felelősségkizárás*, *kötbér*, *vis maior*).
I can say when a party is released from liability (*mentesül a felelősség alól*).
I can say what a contract cannot exclude (*szándékos károkozás*).
